---
name: soft-touch-hertz-sizing
description: Use when sizing any soft elastomer skin to spread millinewton touch onto a discrete sensing element.
source: run 20261102-214941_tactile-fingertip-sensor-for-robot-hands (2026-11-02)
---

1. Get elastomer modulus from Shore A (e.g., Shore 10A silicone) and fingertip/object radii.
2. Compute Hertz contact radius a for light load F: a ~ (F*R/E*)^1/3.
3. Compute mean pressure p = F/(pi*a^2) and spread area vs sensor pitch.
4. Require contact diameter to couple to at least one taxel but localize within 2 mm pitch for human-like resolution.
5. Check membrane can transmit pressure without bottoming or tearing.

Typical values: 1 mN on Shore 10A gives 0.247 mm radius (E9); 1 mN over 1 mm2 taxel gives 1 mN/mm2 pressure (E10); 2 mm pitch taxel gives 212 fF base capacitance (E18).

import numpy as np
dt=1/2200
t=np.arange(0,0.15,dt)
Fn=2.0  # N grip normal per finger
mu=0.5  # silicone-glass friction
Fslip=mu*Fn  # 1.0 N
Ft=np.minimum(1.4*t/0.15+0.1,1.3)  # ramp shear
stick=np.clip(1-Ft/(Fslip+1e-9)*0.5,0,1)  # stick ratio falls
# vibration: 1 um at 200 Hz after microslip when Ft>0.6*Fslip
env=np.clip((Ft-0.6*Fslip)/(0.4*Fslip),0,1)
vib=env*1e-6*np.sin(2*np.pi*200*t)
# 30 ms moving power proxy
w=int(0.03/dt)
pwr=np.convolve(vib**2,np.ones(w)/w,mode='same')
print(f"Fn_N={Fn} mu={mu} Fslip_N={Fslip:.3f}")
print(f"t_microslip_ms={t[Ft>0.6*Fslip][0]*1000:.1f} t_grossslip_ms={t[Ft>=Fslip][0]*1000:.1f}")
print(f"vib_um={1.0} f_Hz=200 detector_window_ms=30 pwr_end={pwr[-1]:.3e}")
print("stick_ratio at 0,50,100ms:",[f"{stick[np.argmin(abs(t-x))]:.2f}" for x in [0,0.05,0.10]])

IP65 sealing and latency-limited teleoperation — from 20261102-153907_lunar-regolith-excavation-robot
IP65 for dusty field electronics means dust-tight with no harmful dust ingress plus protection against water jets from any direction, realized with gasketed sealed box, sealed connectors and cable glands. Non-line-of-sight driving over 5 GHz WiFi FPV has ~100 ms-class video plus control latency, giving order 0.25 m stopping distance even at crawl speed, so the link needs loss-of-heartbeat stop-and-hold. Budget Jetson Orin Nano-class teleoperation overhead at order 29 W and ~1.7 kg for compute, cameras, depth sensing and radio.
Evidence: E29 (search: IP65 enclosure dust sealing standard electronics box: aluleader.com — Aluminum Enclosure IP Rating Guide: Complete Selection Guide for Engineers | Aluleader — https://www.aluleader.com/blog/aluminum-enclosure-ip-rating-guide-for-engineers/); E30 (search: IP65 enclosure dust sealing standard electronics box: cnskyt.com — IP54 vs IP65 Enclosures: Differences, Applications, and How to Choose — https://www.cnskyt.com/ip54-vs-ip65-electrical-enclosures/); E31 (search: IP65 enclosure dust sealing standard electronics box: gorugged.co.za — IP Ratings explained | Blogs | GoRugged SA — https://www.gorugged.co.za/blog-articles/adelia-taljaard/NA/ip-ratings-explained/3); E13 (search: 5 GHz WiFi teleoperation latency FPV camera 100ms robot: geekbuying.com — DJI RoboMaster S1 4WD FPV RC Robot Intelligent Scratch Python Coding — https://www.geekbuying.com/item/DJI-RoboMaster-S1-4WD-FPV-RC-Robot-Intelligent-Scratch-Python-Coding-417200.html); E16 (search: NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano power consumption mass datasheet: technical.city — Jetson Orin Nano 4 GB — https://technical.city/en/video/Jetson-Orin-Nano-4-GB); E19 (stopping distance from latency at crawl speed: 0.25 m); E20 (autonomy power share sum: 29 W); E21 (autonomy mass share sum: 1.73 kg)

Gripper fingertip pressure and soft-skin strain regime — from 20261102-184913_tactile-fingertip-sensor-for-robot-hands
Holding a ~1 kg object needs ~15 N normal per finger assuming friction; nominal robot grip design is ~30 N per fingertip. Over ~300 mm2 this is ~100 kPa nominal with local peaks to ~460 kPa from curvature and dynamics. Shore A 30 silicone with modulus ~1 MPa reaches ~0.46 compressive strain at peaks, near densification, so fingertip elastomers must bottom out or carry overload in rigid structure. Complete fingertip-scale stacks of this type are ~5 g, negligible for grip payload but relevant for finger inertia.
Evidence: E32 (mount load vs grip and drop check: area_m2 0.0003 p_max_kPa 463.3 p_grip_kPa 100.0 F_needed_N 14.8); E34 (skin compressive strain at worst-case pressure assuming 1 MPa modulus for Shore A 30 silicone: 0.463); E38 (mass sum fingertip cartridge for mount payload: 4.89 g)

Slip vibration band and fall latency budget — from 20261102-214941_tactile-fingertip-sensor-for-robot-hands
Slip-induced micro-vibration occupies roughly 100-500 Hz in the Pacinian FA-II band and requires sampling around 1 kHz. Free-fall kinematics allows only ~14.3 ms to limit drop to 1 mm, with ~0.49 mm fall in 10 ms, so sense-to-flag latency must be on the 10 ms order.

IEC 60529 IP65/IP67 dust-tight means first digit 6: complete protection against dust ingress, plus second digit 5 for water jets or 7 for temporary immersion. Electronics exposed to abrasive regolith dust require fully sealed dust-tight boxes, shrouds, and conditioned power to protect signals and links.

proposal.author: Manager
proposal.text: Integrated fingertip: molded Shore A 10 silicone dome (F1 C3) 20 mm dia by 22 mm long with 0.4 mm pitch ridges plus micro-sipes draped as cornea over faceted nail-backed rigid core with M2 screw plus dovetail mount (F2 C21); stack from outside is ridged skin 1.5-2 mm over gel interlayer under 2.5 mm total over PVDF film over capacitive taxels on flat facets of core with flex tail at 3.18 mm bend to on-finger board. Static-dynamic transduction (F3 C18) is capacitive taxels for force plus PVDF vibration film for slip; location (F4 C10) is 2.0 mm pitch grid with centroid to 1 mm; slip (F5 C15) is 100-500 Hz vibration power plus shear-normal check in 30 ms; transmit (F6 C29) is fail-safe dual path with normally-held grip-OK plus 1-bit slip interrupt plus full SPI frame to hand controller. Interfaces: skin pressure to both films, facets carry load to mount, static path via CDC frame and dynamic path direct to MCU ADC, both fused into SPI message. Bench tests: rub-cycle tear, flex continuity under vibration, timed 30 ms slip loop.

key_claims.claim: Fingertip is 20.0 mm diameter by 22.0 mm long, inside human 18.0 mm width by 28.0 mm length and BioTac 26 by 20 by 25 mm precedent, mountable by M2 screw plus dovetail
1.00 mN touch spreads to 0.470 mm spot at 5.78 kPa and transduces to 3.57 fF on 0.269 pF base, giving 14.6 LSB steps over 244 aF LSB
Same array spans 5.78 kPa at 1 mN to 213 kPa at 50 N with 1.33 percent to 48.9 percent strain without saturation, 72.8 kPa at 2 N grip
Slip detector uses 2200 Hz sampling with 30.0 ms window inside 43.2 ms gap from 53.6 ms micro-slip to 96.8 ms gross slip, needing 96.8 thousand MAC per s
On-finger board draws 0.0991 W, sends 51.2 kbit per s at 100 Hz, weighs 14.0 g

selections.rationale: C3 better than C1 clear pad which needs optics absent here and worse interface to capacitive taxels, better than C2 fluid skin which leaks and is harder to mold than solid skin plus gel, better than C11/C16/C27 none statements which carry no means, same-compatible with C25 drape and C7 ridges and C30 sipes which refine C3 but cannot conform alone; only C3 quantifies 1 mN to 0.47 mm spot at 5.78 kPa (E14) with Shore A 10 modulus (E4) under 2.5 mm stack (E2).
selections.author: Manager

selections.rationale: C21 better than C4 clamp alone which gives peel strength but no finger interface, better than C12 faceted core alone which gives array flats but no mount or load rating, better than C17 none statement which carries no means; only C21 gives M2 screw plus dovetail bracket carrying 50 N grip load in the BioTac Product Manual (E43) with 14.0 g mass in the mass budget sum (E53) and incorporates facets in the compound-eye drape sketch (E65).
selections.author: Manager

selections.author: Manager

selections.author: Manager

selections.rationale: C15 better than C7 ridges alone which amplify vibration but decide nothing, better than C13 and C24 none-or-implementation statements which either carry no means or implement C15, better than peripheral-shear alone in Dynamics of fingertip slip (E67) which gives direction but no timing; only C15 gives 44-tap 100-250 Hz FIR at 2200 Hz sampling with 10 ms smoothing and 30.0 ms total window inside 53.6 ms micro-slip to 96.8 ms gross slip gap in the stick-to-slip simulation (E38) needing 96.8 thousand MAC per s in the FIR rate (E78).
selections.author: Manager

selections.rationale: C29 better than C22 SPI frame alone which carries full position-force at 51.2 kbit per s in the SPI rate (E52) but cannot meet 30.0 ms slip latency through 9.00 ms CDC update in the AD7147A Rev B (E41), better than C26 seismic analogy alone which gives dual-path idea without fail-safe wiring, better than C8/C14/C20 none statements which carry no means; C29 keeps C22 frame plus adds normally-held grip-OK heartbeat plus 1-bit slip interrupt per fail-safe track circuit in What is a Track Circuit (E74) and two-channel wiring in How to wire e-stop (E76), runnable at 96.8 thousand MAC per s in the FIR rate (E78) with 1 Msps ADC in STM32 notes (E68).
